passed: The applicant, performance-review, and resignation forms are converted to native dialogs opened with showModal(), with their headings connected through aria-labelledby.
Each launcher is a button with aria-controls and aria-haspopup="dialog"; opening moves focus to the first form field.
Dialogs have a visible Close button, support Escape dismissal, and close on backdrop clicks outside the dialog bounds.
Native dialog closing restores focus to the previously focused launcher for normal user-opened dialogs.
Dialog content can scroll within the viewport, and forms remain available inline if JavaScript or showModal() support is unavailable.
notes: This was a static source review; focus behavior was not verified in a browser or with assistive technology.
